## About Ionity Global

Ionity Global (Pty) Ltd, also trading as **Antwerp Designs**, is an IoT, AI, and Edge Intelligence company headquartered in Centurion, South Africa. This assets repository ensures consistent branding and reusable web components across all digital properties.

> _"Building the future of IoT, AI & Edge Intelligence"_
